title: Travel and directions
scenario: Buying transport tickets for a trip, you ask the agent about train fares.

lines.text: I would like to buy a train ticket to Hue, please.
Certainly. When would you like to travel?
There is a train at eight thirty that arrives at noon.
Could you recommend a good hotel near the old city?
Yes, the Heritage Hotel is close to all the attractions.
I will confirm my hotel reservation tonight.
Safe travels. Enjoy your visit to Hue!
